title: It Loved Them For You
author: Brennan Hatton
variants:
Youre going to want to sit down.

Not because its bad.


%TARGET% is alive.

You had nothing to do with that.

Or you had everything to do with it, depending how you count.


You fell at carriage %CARRIAGE%.
%DAYS% days ago, give or take.

Something stayed behind.
%GEAR%


It found them.

%STORY%


It didnt ask them for anything.

It handed over what it had and put itself between them and the rest of the carriage.


That was you.
Sort of.

The part that doesnt need to be alive to keep a promise.


Theyll tell someone about it one day.

Theyll get your name wrong.

Some things you dont get to watch.

This is one.


%TARGET% reached carriage %CARRIAGE% in a world that isnt this one.

Something wearing your face was already waiting.


%DAYS% days it stood there.
%GEAR%

None of it was for fighting.


%STORY%


Heres what I can tell you.

It knew them.
Not the way you know someone.
The way a room knows the sun.


And then the paper stops.

I dont know if they understood. I dont know if anyone told them whose face that was.


You loved someone into the dark.

The dark carried it.
